statements.proposition: This change modifies Get-MtRoleInfo to look up roles dynamically first and fall back to the static switch list.
statements.label: TRUE
evidence: Patch: try { $roles = Get-MtRoleList; if ContainsKey return } catch ...; then comment 'Fallback to the static switch statement' and switch retained

statements.proposition: This change updates function documentation to explain dynamic validation behaviour.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Help text of Get-MtRoleMember changed; new Get-MtRoleList has its own help. No separate docs file changed, but the claim says function documentation.
evidence: Patch of powershell/public/Get-MtRoleMember.ps1 adds .Description lines: 'Role names are validated dynamically by querying the current role definitions from Microsoft Graph...'

statements.proposition: The change keeps 100% backward compatibility so all existing scripts keep working unchanged.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Universal compatibility claim; no concrete check settles it. Observed possible differences: ValidateSet removal drops tab completion and parameter-binding rejection of invalid names; unknown role now yields a warning and null instead of a binding error; dynamic-validation throw is caught so the advertised error message is never shown. Whether any existing script breaks is not settleable without a tenant.
evidence: Patch of Get-MtRoleMember.ps1: throw inside try is caught by catch that only writes Write-Verbose
Patch of Get-MtRoleInfo.ps1: default branch now Write-Warning and return $null

statements.proposition: The change makes Entra role lists stay current automatically without module updates, preserving full backward compatibility and performance through caching.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Compound outcome claim. Caching via $__MtSession.GraphCache and a Graph query are present in the diff, but currency, performance and full compatibility cannot be settled without a tenant; compatibility part is the same as statement 3.
evidence: Patch of Get-MtRoleList.ps1: queries roleManagement/directory/roleDefinitions and caches in $__MtSession.GraphCache['DirectoryRoleDefinitions']
Static fallback list retained in Get-MtRoleInfo.ps1
